heading: My Mission
eyebrow: How I will strive for it
statement: To turn opportunities for myself into possibilities for everyone.
detail: I believe every person carries a responsibility to use their talents and skills to leave this world fairer than they found it. I hold myself to that same calling. Every skill I develop, every talent I nurture, and every opportunity I receive must serve a purpose greater than my own advancement — the pursuit of the common good. Whatever doors open for me, I must work to open for others. The opportunities I receive must become possibilities for everyone.
